arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because you've noticed a gassy smell, please treat this as urgent. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any flames or light switches near it. Open the windows, and if the smell is there now, leave the flat and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). Call 999 if anyone feels unwell or you are in immediate danger. We're arranging for an engineer to look at the oven and the smell, and a member of our team will be in touch shortly. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked.
